hypotheses.A: Complementary price errors permit convex combinations; optimize either magnitude alone or balanced direction under an error guard.
hypotheses.B: A calibrated downside classifier can route or weight a conditional downside magnitude expert while keeping a low-error default.

specialist: joint_logistic, reused unchanged in both horizons; chosen after the first inspected exploratory study, not an untouched holdout choice
errorBlend: Minimize date-equal MAPE on previous matured OOS forecasts; tie order noChange, priceOnly, then smaller specialist weight; fall back to fixed half if fewer than 3 dates.
jointBlend: Maximize balanced three-class direction subject to calibration guards; ties lower MAPE, then lower return MAE; fall back to causal_error_blend if infeasible.
softMix: p(down) * causal conditional-down MAPE-optimal median + (1-p(down)) * priceOnly
guardedRoute: When p(down) >= threshold and p(down) > p(up), use conditional-down median; otherwise use the chosen default. Choose default/threshold on previous matured OOS forecasts subject to calibration guards; fall back to causal_error_blend if infeasible.
conditionalDownMagnitude: Date-equal weights within previously realized down outcomes, divided by actual price ratio; weighted median minimizes empirical MAPE within down class.
evaluationSplit: same fixed last-half origin dates as the joint v1 study; warm-up forecasts generated causally on earlier origins where sufficient history exists
directionRule: Classify the final numeric forecast using unchanged +/-2% boundary; do not overwrite its sign using the specialist class.
probabilityRule: Only the reference joint model emits a class distribution; numerical blends do not inherit its probabilities. Reference Brier/calibration diagnostics are reported separately.
labelsAvailableRule: Every base specialist fit/calibration respects joint protocol; blend weights and gates use only historical OOS forecasts with targetDate < new origin.
extraGate: Require return MAE >=2% better than both priceOnly/noChange and p90 return error no worse, as well as original magnitude/direction gates. No numerical probability-performance claim.
selection: none; report every declared candidate and every fallback
diagnosticOracle: Per-row best endpoint error is a future-informed impossibility bound, never an executable candidate or promotion input.
codeChangeAfterResultsRule: No post-result hyperparameter or gate adjustment in this protocol; fixes must be disclosed and hash/version updated.
